name: week
title: This week in product compliance
subtitle: What needs a person, which products are not clear, and who owes us an answer

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select issue, ref, rule, detail from v_attention order by issue, ref, rule

sections.title: Products not clear to certify
sections.sql: select product, regulation, status, unknown_parts, failing_parts from v_product_rule where status not in ('compliant','compliant_exemption') order by product, regulation

sections.title: Supplier requests open
sections.sql: select supplier, regulation, array_to_string(part_nos, ' ') as parts, sent_on, due_on, reminders, status from v_open_supplier_requests order by due_on

sections.title: Customer requests open
sections.sql: select c.customer, p.code as product, c.regulation, c.due_on from customer_requests c join products p on p.id = c.product_id where c.status = 'open' order by c.due_on

name: status
title: Product status by rule
subtitle: Every product against every rule that applies in its markets

sections.title: Products
sections.sql: select product, regulation, status, parts, unknown_parts, failing_parts, listed_parts, exemption_parts from v_product_rule order by product, regulation

sections.title: Candidate List substances above 0.1%
sections.sql: select product, part_no, substance, cas, concentration_ppm, coalesce(scip_ref, 'not notified') as scip from v_svhc order by product, part_no

sections.title: Exemptions relied on
sections.sql: select part_no, supplier, exemption, exemption_expires, days_left, used_in from v_exemptions order by exemption_expires nulls last

name: suppliers
title: Suppliers
subtitle: Who has answered, who has not, and conflict minerals templates

sections.title: Declarations missing, expired or stale
sections.sql: select supplier, part_no, regulation, state, received_on from v_part_rule where state in ('missing','expired','stale') order by supplier, part_no, regulation

sections.title: Conflict minerals templates
sections.sql: select supplier, received_on, valid_until, smelters_reported, smelters_not_conformant, state from v_supplier_cmrt order by state, supplier

sections.title: Declarations by supplier
sections.sql: select coalesce(supplier,'(no supplier)') as supplier, count(*) filter (where state in ('compliant','compliant_exemption','contains_listed'))::int as current, count(*) filter (where state in ('missing','expired','stale'))::int as owed, count(*) filter (where state = 'non_compliant')::int as failing from v_part_rule group by 1 order by owed desc, 1
